description: Turn Wi-Fi, mobile data or airplane mode on or off for the whole phone, as in quick settings on Android and iOS. Airplane mode turns both radios off; Wi-Fi can come back on during it, and leaving it restores the radios as they were. Every app sees the result: apps you built read it as {{ network.online }} and {{ network.type }}, and their web data does not load while the phone is offline. The open app's screen is drawn again. Logged in device_log as "connectivity".
name: set_connectivity
